svg.title: Arduino stepper motor wiring
svg.desc: Full-step Arduino circuit with a four-position black motor connector fitted directly over 2B, 2A, 1A, 1B. Wires top to bottom: black, green, red, blue. RESET jumpered to SLEEP; ENABLE and MS1–MS3 unconnected. Arduino D2 to STEP, D3 to DIR, 5V to VDD, GND to lower driver GND. 12V adapter to VMOT and upper GND. A 10 kΩ resistor is inserted directly into Arduino D2, sharing the STEP jumper, and the unused GND socket in the top digital header.

g.title: 10 kΩ resistor leads inserted directly into top-header GND and D2; D2 shares the STEP jumper
